nodes.name: B2 authorize
nodes.notes: Credential type: HTTP Basic Auth. Username = keyId from B2. Password = applicationKey from B2. Get both at https://secure.backblaze.com/b2_buckets.htm -> Application Keys.

meta.description: Monday 6 AM cron. Authorizes against Backblaze B2 API, lists recent files in the backup bucket, alerts Pushover if the most recent file is >30h old (means Sunday 2 AM Hyper Backup didn't run). Success: low-priority (-1) confirmation. Failure: high-priority (1) alert that bypasses quiet hours.
